affordability.description: Income, wealth composition and housing equity of 65+ households

need.description: Life-stage signals: spouse present, mortgage still on the home

reachability.label: Reachability
reachability.description: Whether the pool can be reached efficiently through any channel

whitespace.label: Whitespace (inverse competition)
whitespace.description: Insurance agency density per 1,000 residents aged 60+, inverted

insurability.label: Insurability context
insurability.description: Area-level chronic-condition burden (adults 18+); not individual eligibility

volume.label: Volume
volume.description: Biggest 60+ pools - where the most potential customers live

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Equal-footing trade-off across all six sub-scores

final_expense.label: Final Expense / Guaranteed Issue
final_expense.description: Deep need + ability to pay; higher area disease burden is neutral-to-positive (no underwriting)

legacy_wealth.label: Legacy / Wealth
legacy_wealth.description: Affluent 65+ households with capacity for permanent life and estate planning

spouse_protection.label: Spouse / Mortgage Protection
spouse_protection.description: Couples with dependents and remaining housing obligations

metrics.label: Residents aged 60+
metrics.caveats: Point estimates from the Vintage 2025 postcensal series; no MOE published.

metrics.label: Share of residents aged 60+
metrics.table_field: cc-est2025-agesex: AGE6064 + AGE6569 + AGE7074 + AGE7579 + AGE8084 + AGE85PLUS / POPESTIMATE
metrics.caveats: Age structure only; says nothing about wealth.

metrics.label: Growth of 60+ population, 2020 to 2025
metrics.caveats: Migration and aging-in both contribute; not decomposable.

metrics.label: Median household income, householder 65+
metrics.caveats: 5-year pooled estimate; household income, not personal.

metrics.label: Share of 65+ households with income $75k+
metrics.table_field: B19037 age-of-householder x income; sum of 65+ bands with income >= 75,000 / 65+ total
metrics.caveats: Income is for the whole household; a 65+ householder may live with working-age adults.

metrics.label: Interest, dividend, IRA and pension income per tax return
metrics.caveats: ZIP-based county assignment; suppressed below 20 returns; not age-restricted.

metrics.label: Dividends, interest and rent per resident
metrics.table_field: CAINC4 line 46 (dividends, interest, and rent) / total population
metrics.caveats: Per resident, not per 65+ resident, and it includes rent. It is a wealth-composition signal, not a measure of spending power.

metrics.label: Housing equity proxy for 65+ owners (mortgage-free value)
metrics.table_field: B25027 (65+ owner units without mortgage / all 65+ owner units) x B25077 (median home value)
metrics.caveats: Ecological proxy: median value times a county share; not a household-level estimate.

metrics.label: Share of 65+ adults in a household with a spouse present
metrics.table_field: B09021_024 (65+ living with spouse or spouse of householder) / B09021_022 (65+ total in households)
metrics.caveats: Household coupling proxy, not marital status: the numerator counts people who are a spouse of, or living with, a spouse. Not a proxy for dependents.

metrics.label: Share of 65+ owners still paying a mortgage
metrics.table_field: B25027: 65+ with mortgage / (65+ with + without mortgage)
metrics.caveats: A remaining mortgage is a coverage need signal, not a financial-stress measure.

metrics.label: Share of 65+ households with internet subscription
metrics.table_field: B28005 age x internet subscription; (B28005_016 dial-up alone + B28005_017 broadband) for 65+ / B28005_014 (65+ total)
metrics.caveats: Digital reach proxy; direct mail and field channels are unaffected.

metrics.label: Residents aged 60+ per square mile
metrics.caveats: Density favours compact metro markets; it is not a media-cost measure.

metrics.label: Insurance agencies per 1,000 residents aged 60+
metrics.caveats: CBP excludes most self-employed agents; understates competition in independent-agent states.

metrics.label: Chronic-condition burden index (adults 18+)
metrics.table_field: PLACES crude prevalence: CHD, DIABETES, BPHIGH, CANCER, COPD; mean of per-measure z-scores across counties
metrics.caveats: Area health context for adults 18+, not seniors and not individuals. A standardised index, so the level is not a prevalence. Never use for individual eligibility.

metrics.label: Risk-behaviour burden index (adults 18+)
metrics.table_field: PLACES crude prevalence: OBESITY, CSMOKING, LPA (no leisure-time activity); mean of per-measure z-scores across counties
metrics.caveats: Modifiable area-level behaviours; correlated with income, which is already scored. A standardised index, so the level is not a prevalence.

metrics.label: Expected life-insurance ownership among 65+ households
metrics.table_field: B19037 65+ income distribution x priors.limra_barometer_2026 ownership curve (household-level anchors: under $50k 0.29, $150k+ 0.64)
metrics.caveats: MODELED PRIOR, NOT OBSERVED. National survey rates applied to local income bands.

metrics.label: Estimated uninsured households with a 65+ householder
metrics.caveats: MODELED PRIOR, NOT OBSERVED. Households whose head is 65 or over, not people aged 60+.

metrics.label: Area health context: poor physical or mental health (adults 18+)
metrics.table_field: PLACES MHLTH (poor mental health) + PHLTH (poor physical health) crude prevalence, mean, as a fraction
metrics.caveats: Shown for context only; never used in scoring or filtering. The 2025 PLACES release does not publish the 2023-vintage measures for Kentucky or Pennsylvania, so 187 counties have no value.

popest.name: Census Population Estimates Vintage 2025
popest.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program

acs.name: American Community Survey 2020-2024 5-year, table-based Summary File
acs.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey

cb.name: Census cartographic boundary files 2024
cb.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau cartographic boundary files

irs.name: IRS SOI county income data, tax year 2023
irs.attribution: Internal Revenue Service, Statistics of Income
irs.caveats: ZIP-based county assignment; fewer than 20 returns suppressed; top AGI bracket is $200k+

cbp.name: County Business Patterns 2023
cbp.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau, County Business Patterns
cbp.caveats: Excludes most self-employed; see Nonemployer Statistics for independent agents

places.name: CDC PLACES 2025 release, county data
places.attribution: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, PLACES; funded in part by RWJF
places.caveats: Model-based estimates for all adults 18+, not seniors specifically; release year != data year

rule_R7: This tool NEVER uses race, ethnicity, national origin, religion or disability status in scoring or filtering. Protected-class variables are not present in config/metrics.yaml and must never be added. See docs/METHODOLOGY.md.
